title: Hadoop Online Training
description:
ABOUT HADOOP ONLINE TRAINING:

Hadoop Online Training is Development course teaches the skill set required for the learners the way to setup Hadoop Cluster, the way to store Big Data using Hadoop (HDFS) and the way to process/analyze the large Data using Map-Reduce Programming or by using other Hadoop ecosystems. Attend Hadoop Training demo by Real-Time Expert.
Hadoop Online Training is an open source project by Apache used for storage and processing of huge volume of unstructured data during a distributed environment. Hadoop can proportion from single server to thousands of servers. Hadoop framework is employed by large giants like Amazon, IBM, ny Times, Google, Facebook, Yahoo and therefore the list is growing a day . thanks to the larger investments companies bring Big Data the necessity for Hadoop Developers and Data Scientists who can analyse the info increases day by day.

HADOOP ONLINE TRAINING COURSE PREREQUISITES

  • Basic Unix Commands
  • Core Java (OOPS Concepts, Collections , Exceptions ) for Map Reduce Programming
  • SQL Query knowledge for Hive Queries

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

  • We will Provide Supporting to resolve Student practical Issues.
  • We will provide server Access and 100% Lab Facility.
  • Resume Preparation.
  • Interview Questions & Answers.
  • We will conduct mock interviews. Student also gets 100% supporting before and after getting job.
